significance: A Digambara Jain tirtha near Baldeogarh in Tikamgarh district, known for an eighteen-foot standing (khadgasana) colossus of Shantinatha. The main temple was built in 1180 CE by two brothers, Jahad and Udaichandra, under the Chandela ruler Paramardi, within a phase of Jain building at the site running from the tenth to the thirteenth century.
